segments.t: Graveyard and the edges of Deathknell, all in one loop:
Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons (in the graveyard with the zombies).
Kill Young Scavengers (around the houses) and Ragged Scavengers (east edge, 35-38, 59-66) for 6 Scavenger Paws.
Kill Duskbats (west edge 28-30, 61-67 and south 31-36, 67-73) for 6 Duskbat Wings.

segments.t: Night Web's Hollow (north-west, 27-31, 55-60): kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders outside, then 8 Night Web Spiders in the cave (23-27, 58-61).

segments.t: Scarlet camp east of Deathknell (36-39, 63-70): kill Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates for 12 Scarlet Armbands.

Leave Meven Korgal (36.6, 68.5) alone for now: his documents only drop once you have The Red Messenger.
